name: Monthly currency factor strategies: carry, cross-sectional momentum, time-series momentum
question: Do the best-documented monthly currency premia exist in 2009-2026 data for the seven major currencies against USD, and would they survive retail trading and swap costs?
currencies: EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF, CAD, AUD, NZD against USD (G10 without NOK and SEK, which are not in the archive)
prices: 5 pm New York time (FX day end) on the last weekday of each month, from data/historical_1h_from_15m (close of the hourly bar opening at 4 pm ET); if that bar is missing, the latest earlier bar within the same day. Prices are expressed as USD per unit of foreign currency.
interest_rates: FRED OECD 3-month interbank rates IR3TIB01{US,EZ,GB,JP,CH,CA,AU,NZ}M156N (monthly averages, percent), saved to research/fx_factors/rates.csv. Missing months at the end of a series are filled with its last value (EZ and GB end in January 2026).
excess_return: For holding foreign currency i against USD over a month: log spot change + (rate_i - rate_US) / 100 x days / 365, using that month's rates for the accrual
signal_lag: Signals formed at month-end t use only the rate observation for month t-1 (published during month t) and prices up to t

strategies.carry: Rank the 7 currencies by lagged 3-month rate; long the top 2 and short the bottom 2, weights +0.5 / -0.5 (dollar neutral)
strategies.xs_momentum: Rank by excess return from month-end t-12 to t-1 (12-1 months, Asness-Moskowitz-Pedersen); long top 2, short bottom 2, weights +0.5 / -0.5
strategies.ts_momentum: For each currency, sign of its excess return over the last 12 months (Moskowitz-Ooi-Pedersen); weight sign / 7
strategies.combo: Equal-weight average of the three strategies' monthly returns

sample: Holding months January 2009 to August 2026 (the first 12 months of prices feed the momentum signals)

costs.interbank: Trading cost of 1.5 pips round trip per unit turned over, i.e. 0.75 pip one-way on sum |weight change| per currency at each rebalance, converted to return at that month's price; no swap markup
costs.retail: 3 pips round trip plus a swap markup of 1% per year on gross exposure (sum of absolute weights), an assumption for a typical retail CFD account

statistics: Monthly net returns. Annualized mean, volatility, Sharpe, max drawdown, worst month, skewness. forex_decision_core.stationary_bootstrap_mean_test on monthly returns (mean block length 3, 5000 simulations, seed 42) for a one-sided p-value and 95% CI of the mean.

success_criteria.premium_present: Interbank-cost mean monthly return > 0 with one-sided bootstrap p <= 0.0125 (0.05 / 4 strategies, Bonferroni) and positive mean in at least 2 of the 3 subperiods
success_criteria.usable_at_retail: premium_present and mean monthly return > 0 under the retail cost assumption

use: Research only. Nothing is added to the app from this study; a positive result would first need a separate forward test.
parameter_search: None: the definitions above follow the cited papers and are not tuned
